first_hour._comment: The First Hour's cut list (D95, D97): systems built but hidden until the First Hour plays from the crater to floor 5. Read by src/chronicle/first_hour.gd. Take a name out of `hidden` to bring its system back. coliseum: the Extras entry and the keep doors; training: the Extras entry (the suites still use it); museum: the Extras entry; trivia: no facts found; grimoires: no books for sale; ferries: no sailing; captivity: nobody is taken alive; nemesis: no foe remembers you; dispatch: nobody is sent on errands from the party screen; seasons: no season on the bar, in the journal or the news.
first_hour._comment_guild_mark: D101: nobody climbs without the Guild's mark. With `guild_mark` on, every run starts with the Tower's stair sealed, the way a chapter's end seals it (src/chronicle/chapters.gd), and the first gate the company shuts opens it. `mark_line` is what the Tower's doorkeeper says while it is shut. **Inferred**: the mark is earned by shutting any gate, with or without the Guild's contract on it.
first_hour.mark_line: Nobody climbs without the Guild's mark. Take a contract from the Guild and shut a gate, and the door is yours.

ground_watch._comment: Bands met on the ground (D66, D68). A band stands in the ground of the tile it camps on, and at the edge of any tile its eyes reach. It watches the cells within sight_base + sight_per_reach x its sight (the world's 2), from where it stands; trees, houses and rock block the line, water and every land's liquid do not, and ground that is cover (cover on its terrain in tilesets.json, or named in cover) is never watched. It stands at least keep_away cells further than that from where the party comes in, and patrols a loop of patrol_points stops within patrol_reach cells, a cell every patrol_step_seconds, resting patrol_pause seconds at each, never bringing where the party came in into sight; its red cells move with it. Walking into a watched cell (or being walked into view of) starts the fight there: spotted_seconds of everyone looking, the band rushing charge_share of the way in charge_seconds, then the fight on a field field_margin cells round everyone, field_smallest to field_largest, opening on the ground's own view and drawing back over pull_back_seconds. On the land (D76) a band keeps to its own tile and patrols land_patrol_points stops within land_patrol_reach cells; when the continent moves it to the next tile it walks there across the land, a cell every travel_step_seconds.

classic.blurb: Save whenever you like; the game also saves when you set out, when you rest and when a Tower chapter ends. When your lead falls you may reload the last save, or ascend and choose the next lead.

iron_man.blurb: One life. The game saves itself when you set out, when you rest, when a chapter ends, every time you come back to the map, and when you leave. When your lead falls they ascend, and the save goes with them.

gentle.blurb: Forgiving exploration and testing. Weakened foes, generous spoils, full post-battle recovery, and permadeath disabled.

breeze.blurb: Friction-free testing mode. Party sweeps through battles with high mobility, 10x XP/gold, and zero permadeath.

even.blurb: The game as it is written.

hard.blurb: Preparation is the only thing between you and the ground.

tower._comment_walked: D102: floors 1 to walked_floors are walked, each on its own ground (`walked_area`, with the floor number), with bands watching it and the stair up at the far end; the last is kept by a keeper. Above them a floor is fought as one battle.

opened: A seat opens at the fire.
Word of floor {floor} has gone down the Tower ahead of you. Sellswords who would not look at a company of four stand you drinks now.
{lead} can lead {seats_word} into a fight from today.
party.next_seat: Hire someone in a village or keep to fill it. Floor {next_floor} of the Tower opens one more.
party.all_seats: Hire someone in a village or keep to fill it. Six is as many as anyone has ever kept alive in there.
party.full: Every seat is taken ({seats} of {seats}). Clear floor {next_floor} of the Tower and another opens.

rout.brief: Put down everything that comes at you.

guardian.brief: The thing keeping the far side has to fall. What follows it scatters when it does.

heart.brief: Get one of yours onto the gate's heart and the floor gives way to the next.

lines.fragment: Folded in with it, somebody's map: {place}, out in {region}, {bearing}. It is on yours now.
lines.fragment_stale: Folded in with it, an old map. Everything on it you already know.
